accounting_bases: Historical personal financial statement guidance underlying ASC 274; not a substitute for current Codification text
observations.source_classification: Historical professional standard-setting guidance; source material identified by FASB as the basis for ASC 274
observations.inspected_summary: The reprinted SOP addresses a statement of financial condition for an individual, spouses, or a family. It describes estimated current values for assets, estimated current amounts for liabilities, current-year income taxes payable, and an estimated tax provision on applicable differences between statement amounts and tax bases as if assets were realized and liabilities liquidated at the statement date. It calls for disclosure of methods and assumptions, limits jointly held property to the reporting person's beneficial interest under applicable property law, and says to show a substantial going-concern business interest as one amount rather than combine the separate entity's assets/liabilities with personal items.
